verdict.rationale: Working Copy's site states you can "take part in secure workflows by signing commits" [45]. The manual says a private key, imported or generated in the app, is attached to the commit Identity [20], which points to in-app commit signing. The evidence is a brief marketing line plus one manual sentence, with no detailed signing documentation. missing for 10: explicit statement of which key types are supported for signing (GPG vs SSH), documented signing setup/configuration steps, evidence that signatures verify on hosts like GitHub/GitLab, independent or hands-on corroboration.
